name: Cobalt Optical Terminal
document: Blue Cubed Cobalt Optical Terminal datasheet
notes: Laser terminal: 850 nm, Ethernet 1000BASE-T host interface, adaptive data rate (range/rate curve, no single maximum in the text), full duplex, cross-plane / in-plane / space-to-air / space-to-ground, integrated coarse steering (10 deg/s) and fine steering mirror, hyper-hemispheric field of regard, 2 deg acquisition FOV, self-orienting without host ADCS. Power is 20-30 W by mode (power_w = upper value); bus voltage 40 VDC max. Dimensions 295 mm tall x 255 mm diameter (dynamic volume). Gen 0 prototype performance verified, Gen 1 pending customer interest; a gimbal-less CubeSat version suitable for 6U and larger is mentioned (no data). Not declared: data rate, uplink rate, range.
